title: FZT General_01 values match the site ADS-in ladder

leads.title: FZT General_01 values match the site ADS-in ladder
leads.summary: The eight FZTT_General_01 tiers (f32 at raw offset 100: 0.5, 0.433334, 0.366667, 0.3, 0.25, 0.2, 0.166667, 0.133334 s) match the site ADS_SPD_TIERS within 1.2e-5 ms. FZT_Weapons pairs General_01 and General_10 entries at the same index. This supports candidate ADS-in/ADS-out roles, but does not establish runtime transition directions or exclude a contribution from AZTT; the AZTT-plus-two-frames relation remains a numeric candidate.

question: Do FZT General_01 values match the site ADS-in ladder, and what supports a paired General_10 ADS-out candidate?
sourceFacts: L114: FZT_Weapons Field_e2c9902e pairs a General_01 and a General_10 entry at each index 0-7; every weapon body selects one index through WeaponZoomTransitionIndex, equal to the site defAds on 63/63 weapons.
inference: The General_01 value match and its pairing with General_10 support candidate ADS-in and ADS-out roles respectively. These observations do not establish runtime transition directions or exclude a contribution from AZTT; the earlier AZTT-plus-two-frames relation remains a numeric candidate.
unresolved: Whether General_01 and General_10 are played as ADS-in and ADS-out at runtime (value matching, names and pairing only); attachment shifts of ADS-out (L121).
Whether AZTT contributes to the effective transition timing; the numeric relations do not establish a consumer or composition.
siteImpact: None to current numbers. It supports the ADS-out proposal (L114) with the pairing evidence.
